Now he is developing scars and contractures, with the appearance of brachydactyly. panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Clinical photograph of dorsal feet and ankles in a patient with variegate porphyria showing photodistributed hyperpigmentation, violaceous-brown discoloration, atrophic scarring, and nail dystrophy. The in-text description explicitly attributes these skin changes to variegate porphyria with sun-exposed distribution and secondary changes from vesiculobullous lesions. B: Clinical photograph of dorsal hands in a patient with variegate porphyria showing skin fragility with erosions, milia, atrophic scarring, photodistributed hyperpigmentation, and nail dystrophy. The in-text description explicitly attributes these findings to variegate porphyria with mechanical fragility and sun-exposed distribution.

in_text_mentions: He also had multiple vesicles and bullae over the body in areas exposed to sunlight. The secondary skin changes due to the presence of these vesicular and bullous lesions included skin fragility with erosions from mild shearing trauma, hyper or hypo pigmentations of skin exposed to sunlight, melanosis and violaceous brown discoloration, milia, pseudo-scleroderma, atrophy and scarring of healed skin, alopecia, dystrophic calcification, and non-healing ulceration (Figure 1).
